# BowWow Fun Towne

> A comprehensive dog care facility in Kenmore offering daycare, boarding, training, grooming, swimming, and specialized puppy socialization programs.

BowWow Fun Towne is owned and operated by Mary Mark, a certified professional dog trainer (CPDT-KA, KPA-CTP) with University of Washington Animal Behavior credentials. The facility serves the greater Seattle area including Kenmore, Lake Forest Park, Bothell, Kirkland, Mountlake Terrace, Brier, and Seattle.

## Key Topics

- Dog Daycare
- Pet Boarding & Overnight Care
- Puppy Preschool & Socialization
- Dog Training (Positive Reinforcement)
- Professional Grooming
- Indoor Swimming Pool
- Self-Wash Tubs
- In-Home Pet Care
- Vaccination Requirements (DHLPP, Rabies, Bordetella)
- Facility Rentals
- Mary Mark (Owner/Trainer)
- Temperament Evaluations
- Separation Anxiety Support
- Service Pricing & Rates
- Getting Started Registration

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services): Overview of all BowWow Fun Towne services and facility features
- [Doggie DayCare](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services/doggie-daycare): Detailed doggie daycare service with health requirements and amenities
- [Overnight Care & Boarding](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services/overnight-care): Overnight boarding service with vaccination requirements and amenities
- [Puppy Play Date (Preschool)](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/puppy-play-date): Puppy preschool and socialization program for puppies 8-24 weeks old
- [Dog Training](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services/training): Dog training by Mary Mark using positive reinforcement and clicker methods
- [Professional Grooming](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services/grooming): Professional grooming services from bath to full makeover
- [Pool Play (Swimming)](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services/pool-play): Indoor swimming pool service for dogs with open and private swim options
- [Self-Wash Service](https://bowwowfuntowne.com/services/self-wash): DIY dog wash service with self-service tubs available daily
